To validate the generated and inferred data, a small-scale manual annotation was carried out on 100 items. A total of 9 items (4 generated and 5 inferred) had expected labels inconsistent with the label chosen by the annotators, although the inherent subjectivity of the task can explain many of those discrepancies.
